  path = here::here()

analysis_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "AD_CR_HRS")
data_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "data")
hrs_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "DATASET", "_HARMONIZATION", "data")

# Define Functions

## Load Data

```{r func_load}
get_metadata <- function() {
  pheno_df <- read.csv(file.path(save_dir, "linear_model", "Phenotypes.csv"))
  cpg_ls <- read.csv(
    file.path(save_dir, "comb-p-DMRs", "interact_mQTLs_inputs.csv")
  ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$Sources != "CpG in DMR") %>%
    dplyr::pull("cpgs")

  list(pheno_df = pheno_df, cpg_ls = cpg_ls)
}

get_beta <- function(pheno_df, cpg_ls) {
  # get beta values
  dnam_data <- readRDS(
    file.path(hrs_dir, "batch_corrected", "HRS_White_NHispanic_PCA.RDS")
  )
  beta_data <- SummarizedExperiment::assays(dnam_data)$dnam

  # Filter to samples we used for analysis
  idx <- match(pheno_df$SubjectID_Submitter, dnam_data$SubjectID_Submitter)
  beta_data <- beta_data[, idx, drop = FALSE]

  # Scale Data
  beta_data <- beta_data[cpg_ls, , drop = FALSE] * 100

  beta_data
}

get_data <- function() {
  meta_ls <- get_metadata()
  pheno_df <- meta_ls$pheno_df
  cpg_ls <- meta_ls$cpg_ls

  beta_data <- get_beta(pheno_df, cpg_ls)

  list(pheno_df = pheno_df, cpg_ls = cpg_ls, beta_data = beta_data)
}
```

## LM Summary

```{r func_lm_summ}
# identify the three targets, regardless of term order or scale()
pick_key <- function(term) {
  has_dnam <- str_detect(term, "\\bdnam\\b")
  has_ptau <- str_detect(term, "\\bZ_PTAU181\\b")
  dplyr::case_when(
    has_dnam & has_ptau ~ "dnam_Z_PTAU181",
    has_dnam            ~ "dnam",
    has_ptau            ~ "Z_PTAU181",
    TRUE                ~ NA_character_
  )
}

lm_terms_summary <- function(fit) {
  wide <- broom::tidy(fit) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(term_key = pick_key(.data$term)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$term_key)) %>%
    dplyr::select("term_key", "estimate", "std.error", "p.value") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = "term_key",
      values_from = c("estimate", "std.error", "p.value"),
      names_glue = "{.value}_{term_key}"
    )

  # ensure stable columns even if a term is missing (e.g., dropped for collinearity)
  target_cols <- c(
    "estimate_dnam",
    "std.error_dnam",
    "p.value_dnam",
    "estimate_Z_PTAU181",
    "std.error_Z_PTAU181",
    "p.value_Z_PTAU181",
    "estimate_dnam_Z_PTAU181",
    "std.error_dnam_Z_PTAU181",
    "p.value_dnam_Z_PTAU181"
  )
  for (nm in target_cols) if (!nm %in% names(wide)) wide[[nm]] <- NA_real_
  wide %>%
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(target_cols))
}
```

## Compute Data

```{r func_compute}
#' Build the per-CpG analysis data frame (phenotype data + DNAm for one CpG)
build_cpg_data <- function(ph, B, cpg) {
  cbind(ph, dnam = as.numeric(B[cpg, ]))
}

#' Fit the DNAm x pTau interaction model
fit_interaction_model <- function(dat_i) {
  stats::lm(resid ~ dnam * Z_PTAU181, data = dat_i)
}

#' Compute the 25th/50th/75th (and 0/100th) percentiles of DNAm for a CpG
compute_dnam_percentiles <- function(B, cpg) {
  qs <- stats::quantile(B[cpg, ], c(0, .25, .5, .75, 1), na.rm = TRUE)
  list(
    p25_val = as.numeric(qs[2]),
    p75_val = as.numeric(qs[4])
  )
}

#' Build the newdata grid (pTau sequence crossed with DNAm 25th/75th percentiles)
#' used for predicted-slope plotting
build_prediction_grid <- function(dat_i, p25_val, p75_val) {
  pgrid <- seq(
    min(dat_i$Z_PTAU181, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(dat_i$Z_PTAU181, na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = 101
  )

  new_p25 <- data.frame(
    dnam = p25_val,
    Z_PTAU181 = pgrid,
    grp = "DNAm = 25th percentile"
  )
  new_p75 <- data.frame(
    dnam = p75_val,
    Z_PTAU181 = pgrid,
    grp = "DNAm = 75th percentile"
  )
  newdat  <- rbind(new_p25, new_p75)

  newdat$grp <- factor(
    newdat$grp,
    levels = c("DNAm = 25th percentile", "DNAm = 75th percentile")
  )

  newdat
}

#' Get model predictions (fit + CI) over the prediction grid
predict_slopes <- function(fit_i, newdat) {
  pr   <- stats::predict(fit_i, newdata = newdat, se.fit = TRUE)
  tval <- stats::qt(0.975, df = stats::df.residual(fit_i))

  plot_df <- cbind(
    newdat,
    fit = as.numeric(pr$fit),
    lo  = as.numeric(pr$fit - tval * pr$se.fit),
    hi  = as.numeric(pr$fit + tval * pr$se.fit)
  )

  list(plot_df = plot_df, tval = tval)
}

#' Estimate the simple slope of Z_PTAU181 at a given DNAm value, with 95% CI
compute_simple_slope <- function(fit_i, tval, d) {
  cf <- stats::coef(fit_i)
  V <- stats::vcov(fit_i)
  b_ptau_idx <- which(names(cf) == "Z_PTAU181")
  b_int_idx  <- grep("^dnam:Z_PTAU181$|^Z_PTAU181:dnam$", names(cf))
  stopifnot(length(b_ptau_idx) == 1, length(b_int_idx) == 1)

  b <- c(cf[b_ptau_idx], cf[b_int_idx])
  C <- V[c(b_ptau_idx, b_int_idx), c(b_ptau_idx, b_int_idx), drop = FALSE]
  L <- c(1, d)
  est <- sum(L * b)
  se  <- sqrt(as.numeric(t(L) %*% C %*% L))
  lo  <- est - tval * se
  hi  <- est + tval * se
  c(est = est, lo = lo, hi = hi)
}

#' Build the subtitle text summarizing simple slopes at the 25th/75th DNAm percentiles
build_slope_subtitle <- function(s_p25, s_p75) {
  paste(
    "Estimated pTau slope (95% CI) evaluated at:",
    sprintf(
      "DNAm 25th pct: %.3f [%.3f, %.3f]", s_p25["est"], s_p25["lo"], s_p25["hi"]
    ),
    sprintf(
      "DNAm 75th pct: %.3f [%.3f, %.3f]", s_p75["est"], s_p75["lo"], s_p75["hi"]
    ),
    sep = "\n"
  )
}
```

## Plot Data

```{r func_plot}
get_legend_formatting <- function() {
  theme_pdf <- ggplot2::theme_classic(
    base_size = 11, base_family = "Helvetica"
  ) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      # Figure title
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
        size = 12,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0
      ),

      # Figure subtitle
      plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(
        size = 10,
        face = "plain",
        hjust = 0
      ),

      # X and Y axis titles
      axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 11),
      axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 11),

      # Axis tick labels
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9),
      axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9),

      # Legend
      legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 11),
      legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9)
    )

  theme_pdf
}

#' Plot predicted memory score vs pTau, at DNAm fixed at 25th/75th percentile
plot_dnam_slopes <- function(plot_df, cpg, subtitle_txt) {
  ggplot2::ggplot(
    plot_df,
    mapping = ggplot2::aes(x = Z_PTAU181, y = fit, color = grp, fill = grp)
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_ribbon(
      mapping = ggplot2::aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), alpha = 0.15, color = NA
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste0("CpG ", cpg),
      # subtitle = subtitle_txt,
      subtitle = "DNAm fixed at 25th vs 75th percentile",
      x = "pTau (z-score)",
      y = "Memory score (residual; covariate-adjusted)",
      color = "DNAm fixed at",
      fill  = "DNAm fixed at"
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = 0.05)) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = 0.05)) +
    ggplot2::coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    get_legend_formatting() +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(
        t = 5,
        r = 80,
        b = 5,
        l = 80,
        unit = "pt"
      ),
      plot.title.position = "panel",

      # Legend placement
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.direction = "horizontal"
    )
}

#' Spearman correlation test, ignoring warnings about ties
spearman_test <- function(x, y) {
  suppressWarnings(
    stats::cor.test(x, y, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
  )
}

#' Subtitle text: "<prefix>\nSpearman<symbol> = rho, p = P"
format_spearman_subtitle <- function(prefix, cor_res, symbol = " \u03C1") {
  paste0(
    prefix,
    "\nSpearman", symbol, " = ",
    sprintf("%.2f", as.numeric(cor_res$estimate)),
    ", p = ",
    formatC(cor_res$p.value, format = "g", digits = 3)
  )
}

#' Scatter plot of column y against column x, with a linear trend line
plot_spearman_scatter <- function(
    plot_data, x, y, title, subtitle, x_label, y_label
) {
  ggplot2::ggplot(
    plot_data, mapping = ggplot2::aes(x = .data[[x]], y = .data[[y]])
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
    ggplot2::geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x = x_label,
      y = y_label
    ) +
    get_legend_formatting() +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(
        t = 5,
        r = 3,
        b = 5,
        l = 3,
        unit = "pt"
      ),
      plot.title.position = "panel"
    )
}

#' Spearman correlation between residual cognition and DNAm, plus scatter plot
plot_resid_vs_dnam <- function(dat_i, cpg) {
  cor1 <- spearman_test(dat_i$resid, dat_i$dnam)
  p_resid_dnam <- plot_spearman_scatter(
    dat_i, x = "dnam", y = "resid",
    title = "Residual cognition vs DNAm",
    subtitle = format_spearman_subtitle(paste0("CPG ", cpg), cor1),
    x_label = "DNAm (beta, %)",
    y_label = "Memory score (residual; covariate-adjusted)"
  )

  list(cor = cor1, plot = p_resid_dnam)
}

#' Spearman correlation between pTau and DNAm, plus scatter plot
plot_ptau_vs_dnam <- function(dat_i, cpg) {
  cor2 <- spearman_test(dat_i$Z_PTAU181, dat_i$dnam)
  p_ptau_dnam <- plot_spearman_scatter(
    dat_i, x = "dnam", y = "Z_PTAU181",
    title = "pTau vs DNAm",
    subtitle = format_spearman_subtitle(paste0("CpG ", cpg), cor2),
    x_label = "DNAm (beta, %)",
    y_label = "pTau (z-score)"
  )

  list(cor = cor2, plot = p_ptau_dnam)
}

#' Spearman correlation between pTau and Memory Score, plus scatter plot
plot_ptau_vs_memory <- function(ph, is_resid = FALSE) {
  if (is_resid) {
    ph$memory_score <- ph$resid
  } else {
    ph$memory_score <- ph$VS4MEM_EAP
  }
  cor2 <- spearman_test(ph$Z_PTAU181, ph$memory_score)

  plot_spearman_scatter(
    ph, x = "Z_PTAU181", y = "memory_score",
    title = if (is_resid) "Residual Memory vs pTau" else "Memory vs pTau",
    subtitle = format_spearman_subtitle("", cor2, symbol = ""),
    x_label = "pTau (z-score)",
    y_label = if (is_resid) {
      "Memory score (residual; covariate-adjusted)"
    } else {
      "Memory score (z-score)"
    }
  )
}

#' Build the education-categorized DNAm data frame (0-12 / 13-15 / 16+)
build_education_data <- function(ph, B, cpg) {
  edu_df <- data.frame(
    DNAm = as.numeric(B[cpg, ]),
    Education_years = ph$Education
  )
  to_keep <- is.finite(edu_df$DNAm) & !is.na(edu_df$Education_years)
  edu_df <- edu_df[to_keep, , drop = FALSE]

  edu_df$EduCat <- cut(
    edu_df$Education_years,
    breaks = c(-Inf, 12, 15, Inf),
    labels = c("0-12", "13-15", "16+"),
    right = TRUE,
    ordered_result = TRUE
  )
  edu_df
}

#' Boxplot of DNAm by education category, with Kruskal-Wallis / pairwise Wilcoxon tests
plot_dnam_by_education <- function(edu_df, cpg) {
  kw_p <- tryCatch({
    stats::kruskal.test(DNAm ~ EduCat, data = edu_df)$p.value
  }, error = function(e) {
    NA_real_
  })
  pw <- tryCatch({
    stats::pairwise.wilcox.test(
      edu_df$DNAm,
      edu_df$EduCat,
      p.adjust.method = "BH",
      exact = FALSE
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    NULL
  })

  sub_box <- paste0(
    "Kruskal\u2013Wallis p = ",
    ifelse(is.na(kw_p), "NA", sprintf("%.3g", kw_p))
  )

  p_box_edu <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    edu_df, mapping = ggplot2::aes(x = EduCat, y = DNAm, fill = EduCat)
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8) +
    ggplot2::geom_jitter(width = 0.12, alpha = 0.55, size = 1) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste0("DNAm by Education: CpG ", cpg),
      subtitle = sub_box,
      x = "Education (years)",
      y = "DNAm (beta)"
    ) +
    get_legend_formatting() +
    ggplot2::theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(
        t = 5,
        r = 80,
        b = 5,
        l = 80,
        unit = "pt"
      ),
      plot.title.position = "panel"
    )

  list(kw_p = kw_p, pairwise = pw, plot = p_box_edu)
}
```

## Wrapper Functions

```{r func_wrapper}
#' Assemble a one-row association summary for a CpG (correlations, IQR, model terms)
build_assoc_summary <- function(dat_i, cpg, cor1, cor2, fit_i) {
  n_resid   <- sum(stats::complete.cases(dat_i$resid, dat_i$dnam))
  rho_resid <- unname(as.numeric(cor1$estimate))
  p_resid   <- cor1$p.value

  n_ptau   <- sum(stats::complete.cases(dat_i$Z_PTAU181, dat_i$dnam))
  rho_ptau <- unname(as.numeric(cor2$estimate))
  p_ptau   <- cor2$p.value

  beta_IQR <- stats::IQR(dat_i$dnam, na.rm = TRUE)

  tibble::tibble(
    CpG                 = cpg,
    n_resid             = n_resid,
    spearman_rho_resid  = rho_resid,
    p_resid             = p_resid,
    n_pTau              = n_ptau,
    spearman_rho_pTau   = rho_ptau,
    p_pTau              = p_ptau,
    beta_IQR            = beta_IQR
  ) %>%
    dplyr::bind_cols(lm_terms_summary(fit_i))
}

#' Run the full per-CpG analysis: fit model, generate plots, build summary row
analyze_cpg <- function(cpg, ph, B) {
  cat("\n=====================================================\n")
  cat("CpG:", cpg, "\n")

  dat_i <- build_cpg_data(ph, B, cpg)

  # DNAm percentiles used for evaluation (25th and 75th)
  pctiles <- compute_dnam_percentiles(B, cpg)
  p25_val <- pctiles$p25_val
  p75_val <- pctiles$p75_val

  fit_i <- fit_interaction_model(dat_i)

  # Show Summary
  print(summary(fit_i))

  # --- Predicted slopes plot -------------------------------------------------
  newdat   <- build_prediction_grid(dat_i, p25_val, p75_val)
  pred     <- predict_slopes(fit_i, newdat)
  plot_df  <- pred$plot_df
  tval     <- pred$tval

  s_p25 <- compute_simple_slope(fit_i, tval, p25_val)
  s_p75 <- compute_simple_slope(fit_i, tval, p75_val)
  subtitle_txt <- build_slope_subtitle(s_p25, s_p75)

  p_slopes <- plot_dnam_slopes(plot_df, cpg, subtitle_txt)
  # print(p_slopes)

  # --- Associations with DNAm -------------------------------------------------
  resid_res <- plot_resid_vs_dnam(dat_i, cpg)
  cor1 <- resid_res$cor
  # print(resid_res$plot)

  ptau_res <- plot_ptau_vs_dnam(dat_i, cpg)
  cor2 <- ptau_res$cor
  # print(ptau_res$plot)
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # --- Association with education ----------------------------------------------
  edu_df <- build_education_data(ph, B, cpg)
  edu_res <- plot_dnam_by_education(edu_df, cpg)
  # print(edu_res$plot)
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # --- Association summary table --------------------------------------------
  assoc_summary <- build_assoc_summary(dat_i, cpg, cor1, cor2, fit_i)
  list(
    assoc_summary = assoc_summary,
    p_slopes = p_slopes,
    p_resid = resid_res$plot,
    p_ptau = ptau_res$plot,
    p_edu = edu_res$plot
  )
}
```

## Save Plots

```{r func_save}
#' Draw a page, starting a new PDF page unless it is the first
draw_page <- function(page, first) {
  if (!first) {
    grid::grid.newpage()
  }
  grid::grid.draw(page)
}

#' One or two CpG plots stacked on a letter-size page
plot_pair <- function(cpgs, plot_ls, first = FALSE) {
  # A single plot leaves the second plot's space as bottom whitespace
  bottom_space <- if (length(cpgs) == 1) 5.4 else 0.6

  page <- gridExtra::arrangeGrob(
    grobs = c(
      list(grid::nullGrob()),  # Top whitespace
      unname(plot_ls[cpgs]),
      list(grid::nullGrob())   # Bottom whitespace
    ),
    ncol = 1,
    heights = grid::unit(c(0.8, rep(4.8, length(cpgs)), bottom_space), "in")
  )

  draw_page(page, first)
}

#' A left and a right plot for each of one or two CpGs on a letter-size page
plot_quad <- function(cpgs, left_ls, right_ls, first = FALSE) {
  grobs <- list()
  for (cpg in cpgs) {
    grobs <- c(grobs, list(left_ls[[cpg]], right_ls[[cpg]]))
  }

  page <- gridExtra::arrangeGrob(
    grobs = grobs,

    # NA indicates an empty cell
    layout_matrix = rbind(
      c(NA, NA, NA, NA, NA),  # Top whitespace
      c(NA,  1, NA,  2, NA),  # Top row of plots
      if (length(cpgs) == 1) {
        c(NA, NA, NA, NA, NA)  # Empty bottom row
      } else {
        c(NA,  3, NA,  4, NA)  # Bottom row of plots
      },
      c(NA, NA, NA, NA, NA)   # Bottom whitespace
    ),

    # Total width = 8.5 inches
    widths = grid::unit(
      c(
        0.45,  # Left page margin
        3.75,  # Left plot column
        0.10,  # Gap between columns
        3.75,  # Right plot column
        0.45   # Right page margin
      ),
      "in"
    ),

    # Total height = 11 inches
    heights = grid::unit(
      c(
        0.8,  # Top page margin
        4.8,  # Top row
        4.8,  # Bottom row
        0.6   # Bottom page margin
      ),
      "in"
    )
  )

  draw_page(page, first)
}

#' Save a letter-size PDF with two CpGs per page, sorted by CpG name.
#' draw_cpgs(cpgs, first) draws the page for one or two CpGs.
save_paged_pdf <- function(cpg_ls, plot_name, draw_cpgs) {
  pdf_name <- file.path(save_dir, "plots", plot_name)
  pdf(pdf_name, width = 8.5, height = 11)

  for (index in seq(1, length(cpg_ls), 2)) {
    draw_cpgs(
      cpg_ls[index:min(c(length(cpg_ls), index + 1))],
      first = index == 1
    )
  }

  dev.off()
}

save_single_plot <- function(plot_ls, plot_name) {
  save_paged_pdf(
    sort(names(plot_ls)),
    plot_name,
    function(cpgs, first) plot_pair(cpgs, plot_ls, first = first)
  )
}

save_both_plot <- function(left_ls, right_ls, plot_name) {
  save_paged_pdf(
    sort(names(left_ls)),
    plot_name,
    function(cpgs, first) plot_quad(cpgs, left_ls, right_ls, first = first)
  )
}

plot_memory <- function(ph, plot_name) {
  p1 <- plot_ptau_vs_memory(ph, is_resid = FALSE)
  p2 <- plot_ptau_vs_memory(ph, is_resid = TRUE)

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = file.path(save_dir, "plots", plot_name),
    plot = gridExtra::arrangeGrob(p1, p2, ncol = 2),
    width = 8,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300,
    bg = "white"
  )
}
```

# Run Analysis

## Load Data

```{r load}
data_ls <- get_data()

B <- data_ls$beta_data
ph <- data_ls$pheno_df
cpg_ls <- data_ls$cpg_ls
```

## Loop CpGs

```{r loop}
slopes_ls <- list()
resid_ls <- list()
ptau_ls <- list()
edu_ls <- list()
# start empty so a rerun in the same session cannot keep old rows
all_assoc_summaries <- NULL

for (cpg in cpg_ls) {
  cpg_res <- analyze_cpg(cpg, ph, B)
  assoc_summary <- cpg_res$assoc_summary
  slopes_ls[[cpg]] <- cpg_res$p_slopes
  resid_ls[[cpg]] <- cpg_res$p_resid
  ptau_ls[[cpg]] <- cpg_res$p_ptau
  edu_ls[[cpg]] <- cpg_res$p_edu

  all_assoc_summaries <- dplyr::bind_rows(all_assoc_summaries, assoc_summary)
}
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(all_assoc_summaries$CpG))

write.csv(
  all_assoc_summaries,
  file = file.path(save_dir, "linear_model", "all_assoc_summaries_MCI.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
